title: Using TheySix Support
summary: What to collect before opening a ticket and which TheySix support category matches your issue.

body.text: TheySix Support is intended for real farm, server, and community issues. Do not create tickets just to test the system; misuse can result in moderation action. Choose the closest ticket category and include enough technical detail for the support team to reproduce the problem.

items: State whether you are playing Java Edition or Bedrock Edition.
Say whether the world is singleplayer or multiplayer.
List any mods, add-ons, or plugins.
Provide the farm's tutorial or YouTube link.
Describe exactly what is going wrong and when it happens.
Attach a screenshot or video. For advanced problems, include a world download or schematic if possible.
Java Farm: help with Java farms and farm mechanics.
Bedrock Farm: help with Bedrock farms and Bedrock-specific behavior.
Report a Bug: server bugs, glitches, exploits, or technical issues.
Report a Person: rule-breaking, griefing, stealing, harassment, or other misconduct; provide evidence.
Partnership: collaboration requests from creators, community leaders, or brands. TheySix does not accept partnership tickets from Minecraft servers.

body.text: A Bedrock farm not working on a multiplayer server may be affected by the server software or configuration. Ask the server staff whether it is a Java or Bedrock server, then use the matching support category; using a Bedrock client does not change the server edition.

If you do not know what DN means, find the Download Number in the video's description and run /dn followed by that number in the bot channel. The bot will return the associated world and schematic archive links.
